passages.text: Dianthus carthusianorum, commonly known as Carthusian pink, is a species of Dianthus, native to Europe, from Spain north to Belgium and Poland, and east to Ukraine, occurring in dry, grassy habitats at altitudes of up to {{convert|2500|m|abbr=on}} in mountains.

It is a variable herbaceous perennial plant growing to {{convert|60|cm|abbr=on}} tall. The leaves are slender, green to slightly glaucous greyish-green, up to {{convert|7|cm|abbr=on}} long and {{convert|5|mm|abbr=on}} broad. The flowers are {{convert|18|-|20|mm|abbr=on}} wide, dark pink to purple, occasionally white; they are produced several together in tight flowerhead.
